subject: Overcounted ingestion spikes — request for credit and VAT handling
messages:
From: Lara Singh <lara.singh@olivetech.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, billing@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Overcount on February invoices — request for credit and VAT evidence

Hi David / Redwood billing team,

We ran reconciliation this morning and noticed a repeated ingestion job between 2026-02-23 02:14:00 UTC and 2026-02-23 02:47:00 UTC that looks like it was processed three times by your endpoint. That spike shows up as ~2.1M additional tokens on invoice 2026-02-28 (attached).

Can you please:
- Confirm whether the duplicate ingestion was on Redwood's side or ours (we can share logs)
- Provide a proposal for a credit (goodwill + corrective credit) and timing
- Confirm how VAT will be handled for any retroactive credit (we are EU-registered)

I attached a quick reconciliation CSV (reconciliation_Q1-olivetech.csv) with the affected invoice id and the sample timestamps. We have temporarily paused future large batch replays until we hear back.

This is impacting our month-end close; if possible we would like a provisional offset or billing hold while you investigate.

Thanks,
Lara Singh
Head of Cloud Ops, OliveTech
Lara.Singh@olivetech.com
+1 415-555-0182

Attachment: reconciliation_Q1-olivetech.csv (CSV, 26 KB)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Lara Singh <lara.singh@olivetech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, billing@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 4 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Overcount on February invoices — request for credit and VAT evidence

Hi Lara — thanks for flagging and for the reconciliation file. We take overbilling reports seriously and will prioritize this.

Quick notes / next steps:
1) I opened an incident with the serving team to look specifically at the ingress/job dedup window you called out. They requested the raw request IDs and your replay logs for that 02:14–02:47 UTC window. If you can share the replay bundle or any request IDs we can short-circuit the root cause.
2) Finance is prepared to provision a provisional goodwill offset of up to $8,000 to avoid disrupting your close, pending validation (this will show as a temporary credit on account HUB-3241). Any final credit will be reconciled once investigation completes.
3) For VAT: please confirm your EU VAT registration number and whether you require a credit note with VAT reversal documentation; our finance team will need the VAT ID and the billing contact.

If you can send the requested logs and confirm the VAT ID I will loop in Marissa from billing to coordinate the provisional offset and timing.

Best,
David Kim
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference
david.kim@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0176

Attachment: invoice_2026-02-28.pdf (referenced)

From: Tom Rios <tom.rios@olivetech.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lara Singh <lara.singh@olivetech.com>
Date: Thu, 5 Mar 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Overcount on February invoices — request for credit and VAT evidence

David — thanks for the quick reply. Attached are two things: (1) a small sample bundle of the replay logs (usage_samples_202603.zip) containing request IDs and timestamps, and (2) the invoice PDF you referenced for clarity.

Invoice numbers: RT-2026-02-28-OLV-113 and RT-2026-02-28-OLV-114. The duplicated run shows the same job id popping 3x in your logs.

Our VAT number is GB999999973. We will need a formal credit note for our records if a retroactive credit is issued (EU VAT reverse-charge reversal). Please advise the format your finance team requires.

We appreciate the provisional offset proposal — if you can apply that while the team investigates it will help our AR process.

Thanks,
Tom Rios
Revenue Operations, OliveTech
Attachment: usage_samples_202603.zip (ZIP, 3.4 MB)
Attachment: invoice_2026-02-28.pdf (PDF, 210 KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Finance Team <finance@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Billing Ops <billing@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 6 Mar 2026 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Overcount on February invoices — request for credit and VAT evidence

Team — tagging for action. Summary:
- Customer: OliveTech (HUB-3241) reported duplicated ingest event causing ~2.1M extra tokens across two invoices.
- Provided: reconciliation CSV, sample usage bundle, invoice numbers, VAT ID (GB999999973).
- Customer requests provisional offset while we investigate.

Proposed internal plan: 
1) Apply provisional goodwill credit of $8,000 to OliveTech account today (show as temporary credit, valid for 30 days) to unblock AR. Mark as "provisional-investigation" in ledger.
2) Supply OliveTech with a standard credit note template and request their VAT certificate if they want VAT reversal documentation. Finance to produce final credit note if investigation confirms our overcount.
3) If investigation shows the duplicate processing occurred on our side, issue a corrective credit equal to the difference on invoices RT-2026-02-28-OLV-113 and -114 and update VAT handling per customer's certificate. If the cause is on their replay/process, offer a goodwill concession of up to $3,000.
4) Capture impact for Q1 metrics and mark as "service-credit" category for reporting.

Jordan — can you create the provisional credit entry and draft the credit note template (use DocuSign link below for final sign-off if required)? Finance — I need confirmation that provisional crediting is within our policy for this amount; if any approvals are needed escalate to VP Finance.

DocuSign (template): https://www.docusign.net/olivetech/agree/ABCD1234
HubSpot record: 10457234

Thanks — I will reply to OliveTech after credit is provisioned.

Marissa Cole
Director, Billing & Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0199
